summary: Which payment sandbox should the checkout fixtures hit?
body: The checkout fixtures need a sandbox account. Two exist in the vault: `stripe-test-eu` (used by the old suite) and `stripe-test-us` (the one billing uses today). Only you know which one stays. Yes = keep `stripe-test-us` and retire the EU one; no = keep both and I pin the fixtures to EU.
